text:
kevin: FYI onboarding quant4-hybrid for atlas-14b on long-doc eval shows non-monotonic rotable indices and a micro-duplication around token boundary 58982. attaching micro-harness + kv dump.

anya: which kernel and which quant pipeline? any env diffs vs hosted?

kevin: ran on private (trt-fastpath) with quant pipeline `qp-v1.2-quant4hybrid`. cmd: `./long_eval --model=atlas-14b-quant4 --ctx=60000 --repeat=12 --kv-mode=private --kernel=trt-fastpath --kv-trace=rotable,kvcache`

maria: paste log excerpt please.

kevin: small snippet from repro logs:
```
[2026-03-27T09:11:22Z] rotable_access: pos=58980 freq_idx=235920 -> ok
[2026-03-27T09:11:22Z] rotable_access: pos=58981 freq_idx=235921 -> ok
[2026-03-27T09:11:23Z] rotable_access: pos=58982 freq_idx=2147483647 -> SENTINEL: int32_max
[2026-03-27T09:11:23Z] gen: "...she closed the book" -> "...she closed the book she closed"  <-- shifted repeat
```
KV snapshot: s3://redwood-qa/triage/1849999988/kv_snapshot.bin

anya: int32 max sentinel is new; previous bugs were u32/u64 saturations. int32 suggests an accidental cast to signed 32-bit somewhere in the freq index compute. did you run int8 as control?

kevin: int8 portable kernel runs clean. trt-fastpath/int8 also clean. only quant4hybrid/trt-fastpath hits this ~20% runs in our matrix.

eng-runtime-bot: CI:long-onboard/1849999988 started. matrix: kernels=[trt-fastpath,portable], quant=[quant4hybrid,int8], ctxs=[58982,58983,60000]. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/long-onboard/1849999988

maria: triage plan: 1) re-run with `--kv-index-type=uint64 --pack-stride-check=on --asan=1` to see if sentinel disappears; 2) bisect PRs touching quant packer and trt kernels in the last 2 weeks; 3) add a small unit that repeatedly appends a 7-token anchor crossing 58982 and asserts monotonic freq_idx; 4) add failfast assert in rotable accessor for debug builds if freq_idx==INT32_MAX or freq_idx<0.

kevin: re-ran debug build with `--kv-index-type=uint64` and `--pack-stride-check=on`. results: sentinel gone and dupes vanished in 40/40 noisy runs. uploaded debug logs: s3://redwood-qa/triage/1849999988/debug_runs.zip

anya: that strongly implicates a 32-bit signed cast in the trt-fastpath quant pack kernel. i can bisect kernel changes. also, we should add telemetry that counts occurrences of repeated anchors in production as signal.

ci-bot: quick CI note: portable/quant4hybrid reproduced 0/100, trt-fastpath/quant4hybrid reproduced 9/100. debug uint64 build 0/100.

maria: created BUG-ML-5227 (atlas14b-quant4-trt-int32-sentinel) and assigned to @eng-runtime with priority P1. suggested short-term mitigation: gate fastpath for ctx>48k for quant4hybrid until fix, and add debug assert and regression test.

kevin: added micro-harness and attached failing input to the bug. also uploaded a small canary binary built with the uint64 index fix for testing. s3://redwood-qa/triage/1849999988/canary_bin

anya: i'll prepare a small patch to avoid casting to int32 in the freq index math and add an assertion in the trt kernel to catch negative or sentinel values. will run perf to see impact.

maria: thanks. once we have a candidate patch and canary, we'll run a targeted rollout to private and staging and monitor anchor-repeat telemetry. ping back here with patch sha and canary results. :thumbsup:
